description: Set start_time and/or end_time (ISO with offset) on a campaign or ad squad. end_time must be in the future and after the start. A change that lets an ACTIVE item deliver sooner (an earlier start, or reviving an ended item) is checked and limited like enabling it. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name: snap_set_schedule
